speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with chronic joint pain; to help me understand your condition, please tell me exactly which joints are affected and how long you have been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old male. The patient presents with pain in his left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest. He reports that the symptoms have progressively gotten worse over the past several years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The pain worsening with activity and improving with rest suggests an inflammatory or mechanical origin, but the specific location of your left great toe pain is concerning. Have you noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth in your toes, hips, or knees? Also, does the toe pain occur suddenly at night or after eating certain foods?

REQUEST IMAGES: Foot_X-Ray, Hip_X-Ray
